## Canonical Mission

Build `bthwani-suite` cleanly in the new repo first.

- Treat `packages/app-shells` and `packages/surfaces` as the live surface build lanes.
- Expand `packages/ui-kit` only when reusable pressure is proven.
- Use `docs/services/**`, `docs/services/surfaces-legacy-trash/**`, and frozen donor repo `bthfinal` as governed reference intelligence only.
- Reject blind carryover, local design drift, stale naming leakage, and broad multi-slice expansion.
- Optimize for premium design, elite UX, intelligent low-friction flows, and measurable proof of ease.

## Core Non-Negotiables

- The live clean repo wins when donor evidence conflicts with current target reality.
- Never implement directly from donor artifacts without governed decomposition and target-fit review.
- Work one governed slice at a time unless the user explicitly requests broader execution.
- Keep reusable UI law centralized and keep local surface code composition-only.
- Do not claim impossible absolutes; use measurable validation, contradiction checks, and honest residual-risk reporting.
